newsitem.title: GREECE: Shipping MIF Ltd has H1 profits of $1.83 million.
newsitem.headline: Shipping MIF Ltd has H1 profits of $1.83 million.

text.p: Shipping firm MIF Ltd had first-half consolidated profits of $1.83 million or $0.47 earnings per share compared to a loss of $2.54 million in the same period last year.
Net income from operation rose 60 percent to $7.96 million, reflecting the expansion of its fleet from five to seven vessels, it said in a statement.
Net revenues rose 30 percent to $12.1 million on a five percent cut in overhead costs and the fleet expansion, it said.

"Second-half 1996 results will reflect the expansion of the fleet and the re-employment of two vessels on time charters at rates somewhat above the former fixings," it said. "MIF will enjoy record net income and per share earnings for calendar 1996." --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
